items.text: Rams WR Davante Adams is out 6-10 weeks after hamstring surgery and K Blake Grupe is on IR (torn ACL); TE Terrance Ferguson is on IR.
Rams DL Kobie Turner went to IR; CB Trent McDuffie (groin) and LB Nate Landman (concussion) did not practice Wednesday.
Raiders TE Brock Bowers (hamstring/calf) and LT Kolton Miller (shoulder) were limited Wednesday; Kirk Cousins starts.

adjust.reason: The Rams are without Davante Adams, Kobie Turner and their kicker, and McDuffie and Landman missed practice. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
